title: Manual check in the DAW: chop-shop-mixed against apricity render, loudness within 1 LU
description:
## Intent

Prove the mix in the DAW.

## Steps (manual, the owner with the DAW)

1. `apricity export --daw-set examples/chop-shop-mixed.apr -o /tmp/daw/csm.als`; `apricity render examples/chop-shop-mixed.apr -o /tmp/daw/csm.wav`.
2. Open the set: groups, returns, sends, devices in order, sidechain keyed; export the DAW's own bounce to `/tmp/daw/csm-daw.wav`.
3. `analysis/.venv/bin/python scripts/check-render.py examples/chop-shop-mixed.apr /tmp/daw/csm-daw.wav` and compare loudness with the render (within 1 LU); A/B listen.

## Verification

A comment with the DAW version, both loudness readings and listening notes; mismatches filed as bugs.

## Release

No commit.
